title: Hiring Senior AI & Automation Operations Lead (n8n & Make Specialist) | Remote
text: About the Role We are a Saudi-based AI & Digital Transformation Agency building end-to-end digital systems, WhatsApp AI engines, process automations, and CRM integrations for fast-growing businesses in the Arab world and MENA region. We are looking for a Hands-on AI & Operations Lead to help us build a fully AI-First operational hub . This is not a traditional PM role — we need a system builder, an automation architect, and a problem solver who loves turning complex operational bottlenecks into sleek, automated n8n & Make.com workflows. What You’ll Be Building & Managing AI-First Operations: Designing and deploying scalable workflows using n8n , LLM APIs (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini), and custom webhooks to eliminate repetitive internal tasks. WhatsApp AI Automations: Building advanced WhatsApp Business API flows integrated with CRMs and AI agents for client and internal operations. Content Engine Automations: Setting up end-to-end workflows for multi-channel content generation, scheduling, and asset creation (text, image, reel scripts/video inputs). Project & Delivery Management: Leading internal dev/design projects, managing freelancers, and ensuring deliverables meet quality and architecture standards. Systems & SOPs: Writing clear operational documentation and continuously optimizing agency workflows. Requirements & Tech Stack Expertise in n8n & Make.com : Advanced workflow design, self-hosting/deployment concepts, custom Webhooks, JSON parsing, JS/Python code nodes, Error handling, and API calls. Daily hands-on AI usage: Deep integration experience with LLM APIs (ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) and AI Agents. PM & Ops Experience: Proven background leading digital projects or operational teams inside a startup or digital agency. Tooling: Proficient in Google Workspace, ClickUp/Asana/Notion, WhatsApp Business API integrations, and modern PM tools. Mindset: Extreme ownership, self-driven, and obsessed with system scalability and clean workflow architecture. Perks & Contract Details Type: Long-term, ongoing renewable contract (Project/Contract-based). Location: 100% Remote. Hours: Flexible hours Growth: High potential to step into a core leadership role as the agency scales. How to Apply Please drop a reply or private message with: A brief introduction & your background in automation/operations (mention any experience with Middle East / GCC projects). Your daily AI & Automation stack (e.g., n8n nodes, Make scenarios, tools, models). Showcase: 1–2 real-world complex automation workflows you’ve built in n8n or Make.com (screenshots, Loom videos, or architecture descriptions are highly welcome!). Your weekly hourly availability and time zone. What’s the biggest automation or AI system you’ve managed from scratch?
triage_reason: Company looking to hire a remote AI and automation lead.
